title: Maiorana–McFarland formula on joined blocks
statement:
Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $g$ map the $n$-dimensional cube over $\mathbb F_2$ to $\{\pm1\}$, and take $x,y\in\mathbb F_2^n$. The Maiorana–McFarland function evaluated on the joined blocks $(x,y)$ equals
\[(-1)^{\langle x,y\rangle}\,g(y),\]
where the inner product is in $\mathbb F_2$ and is converted to its corresponding sign.
hypotheses_covered: $x,y$ are elements of the $n$-dimensional $\mathbb F_2$ cube
